audit.why: EVEN at 6/10 matches 49.11% over 1468 games and matches the already-audited zac__sion side, which also frames it as even overall with Zac owning the middle stages.

audit.whatIsWrong: This side's chart reads Skill/Sion/Sion/Skill/Skill/Sion/Sion. The already-applied Zac side aligned both of its layers to Skill/Zac/Zac/Skill/Skill/Zac/Sion. Three rows — Level 2, Level 3 and first item — disagree between the two directions.
audit.why: MIRROR REUSE, not a fresh judgement: the opposite page is already written and shipped, and its reasoning is sound — Unstable Matter takes a percent of maximum health on a 5-second cooldown, so the HP Sion stacks is the stat that scales Zac's damage. I restate the same facts from Sion's side rather than re-litigating them. Two directions must not contradict, and mirror-fix.js would overwrite this side anyway.
audit.corrected: Rows 1, 2 and 5 set to Zac in both layers, ratings 5/10 -> 3/10. Row 6 already reads Sion and matches the mirror, so it is untouched.

audit.whatIsWrong: Elastic Slingshot was given as '16 seconds of vulnerability' at level 6. It is 21/18/15/12/9 — 18s at the rank he would have at 6, and never 16 at any rank. Unstable Matter was described only as a 'W-slap' with no mention that it deals a percentage of maximum health on a 5-second cooldown, and Stretching Strikes was never identified as an auto-attack reset.
audit.why: The percent-max-health point is the whole matchup: it is the reason Sion's core build feeds the enemy and the reason the mirror scored the middle stages to Zac.
audit.corrected: Real E cooldown in mid and whys[2]; percent-health W in whys[1] and whys[5]; the Q reset tell in wants.foe[0].

edits.before: Your W-shield comes up and his first W-slap is easy to absorb — detonate it for chip and land a short charged Q to establish lane pressure.
edits.after: Unstable Matter is a 5s cooldown that burns a percent of your max HP — the shield absorbs one slap, never the loop, so take a single trade and leave.

edits.before: His E slingshot is online but fully telegraphed — hold a charged Q to stun him on landing and punish whiffs with a free E-armor-shred follow-up.
edits.after: Elastic Slingshot is 21s at rank 1 and fully telegraphed — stun him on landing, but the trade only pays if you also step on the blobs he sheds.

edits.before: Heartsteel HP stacks compound on your kill-passive; sustained brawls with W-shield active favor you and Zac's low damage-per-second can't outpace your bulk.
edits.after: Heartsteel compounds your HP, but Unstable Matter takes a percent of maximum health — every stack you add makes his slap hit harder, so keep it to one exchange.

edits.before: From levels 4-5 Zac starts using his E more aggressively to fish for CC chains into his team or to escape trades that go wrong; this is his strongest evasion window because his blob sustain lets him absorb chip and retreat. Respect the slingshot range and don't over-extend to charge a Q — if he bails with E you've wasted the commitment. At level 6 your R is an effective counter-slingshot tool: if he burns his E to escape, R into his path to deny the disengage; if he misses the slingshot you have a free all-in window because his cooldown is 16 seconds of vulnerability.

At level 6 your R is an effective counter-slingshot tool: if he burns his E to escape, R into his path to deny the disengage; if he misses the slingshot you get a free all-in, because that is 18 seconds of vulnerability at rank 2.

edits.before: Slingshot (E) onto you from an angle that makes the full-charge Q telegraph hard to track
edits.after: Open with the Stretching Strikes reset — its wind-up is the tell — then slingshot in behind it

notes: MIRROR REUSED: audits/top/zac__sion existed, so the mechanical findings (chart alignment, percent-max-health W, slingshot cooldown) were restated from Sion's side rather than re-derived, and the three chart rows now agree in both directions. Both packet suspectNames are FALSE POSITIVES — 'Elastic Slingshot' and 'Cell Division' are the correct Riot names. NOT WRITTEN, deliberately: the _missing file asks for a Grievous Wounds line, but the healing in question is Cell Division's blob reabsorption and revive, and nothing in the kit text establishes that Grievous Wounds reduces a revive. Claiming it would be a guess, so the existing 'step on the blobs' advice was kept instead.
